A remarkable nursery and primary school in Lane End, Buckinghamshire, open for children aged 2 to 11.
Welcome from our Headteacher
We are a village school and nursery, and we get to know our children and families really well. We want every child to feel safe, supported and encouraged to be the best they can be.
In September 2026, we began an exciting new journey as part of Chiltern Way Academy Trust. We are keeping what makes our school special, while bringing in new ideas, opportunities and support to help us make the school even better.
We want The Orchard Way to be a school that children love coming to, where staff love working and where families feel welcome and part of things.
If you are thinking about The Orchard Way for your child, come and have a look around. I would be very happy to show you our school and introduce you to the people who make it such a special place.
Debbie WilliamsHeadteacher

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum Intent | The Orchard Way Academy
pageCache.text:
Curriculum Intent
At The Orchard Way Academy, we use the National Curriculum to deliver a ‘small steps’ curriculum in order to support the acquisition of mastery for each subject.
Curriculum Intent
Mixed-age teaching offers a number of advantages:
Most importantly, being in a mixed-age class does not mean children receive a reduced or repeated curriculum. Teachers plan carefully from the National Curriculum expectations for each year group, ensuring clear progression in knowledge and skills. Where themes or contexts are shared, learning is designed at the appropriate level for each year group.
Our mixed-age structure reflects what we value as a school: children being known as individuals, learning from and with one another, and receiving the right balance of challenge and support to help them thrive.
